name: Typed Capability System
source_state: standalone seed snapshot; source and artifact hashes recorded together

release_terminal.qemu_tests: profile-tagged first output, exact UART responses, live status, denied reads, editing, malformed input, and three serial-break recovery cases passed

reduction_latch.unknown_input_bits: permanently inhibit both slots; retain pending work; no fabricated confirmations

lifecycle_runtime_test.approval_and_audit: explicit public test-fixture decisions, not authenticated administration or audit
lifecycle_runtime_test.gate_owner: supervisor; broker checks each admission/completion via private protected call
lifecycle_runtime_test.quiescence_scope: one broker-owned ticket; no external resource effects, data release, disk, DMA or delegated I/O

native_crypto_build.timing_claim: consult exact GitHub Actions runs; command-count reduction is not a controlled benchmark

operator_host_workflow.host_scope: trusted local Linux/macOS filesystem; absolute real paths outside Git checkouts; no extended ACL
operator_host_workflow.review_digest: BLAKE2b-256 over domain/mode, public key, canonical signed message
operator_host_workflow.key_source: operator-invoked OS getentropy; real keygen path compiled but not executed during development/tests
operator_host_workflow.test_credentials: public RFC fixtures only; separate mode/binary and deterministic entropy
operator_host_workflow.failure_evidence: key/context/approval mismatch; malformed inputs; file/ACL/link/repository rejection; entropy failure; four concurrent signers with one winner; partial writes and injected fsync failure preserve reservations
operator_host_workflow.launch_reservation: exclusive launch.used before image copy/exec; failed launches remain consumed; local trusted filesystem, not rollback-proof
operator_host_workflow.launch_image: bounded private launch.img copy, pinned working directory, raw loading, no extra inherited descriptors

interactive_fixture.credential: public RFC 8032 vector 1; fresh host test-launch nonces
interactive_fixture.invalid_launch_checks: repeated NOT_READY submissions, unchanged restricted status, denied reads; absent/malformed/mode/key/legacy/DMA context; operator rejects mode-flipped RFC fixture
interactive_fixture.native_bootstrap_failures: both adapters: 64 wrong counts, seven labels, 128 header bit mutations, zero fields; no execution; reinit preserves live context and replay state
interactive_fixture.native_reply_failures: every defined admission status plus invalid values; 64 wrong counts, six labels, all 13 corrupted receipt words; uncertain is not rejection; loss while echo blocked never submits
interactive_fixture.qemu_checks: actual host one-shot launch and review/sign; exact framing, replay, cross-launch context, signature/shape rejection, live policy/read checks, stale generation, audit-full reductions, loss discard and cancellation
interactive_fixture.native_checks: signed frame lengths 0-386; all 256 byte classes; loss/cancel at every position; real terminal partial TX, echo ordering, exact IPC/receipt correlation; launch administrator adapter

signed_admin_core.verification_dependency: unmodified Monocypher 4.0.3 with optional Ed25519 module
signed_admin_core.host_tests: sanitized RFC 8032 vectors 1-3; 1536 single-bit mutations; exact encoding/length; context/key/replay/busy/completion/exhaustion and conditional policy/audit cases passed
signed_admin_core.cross_compilation: four administration/crypto source files compiled for freestanding AArch64

boot_context_test.transport: exclusive fw_cfg MMIO owner; exact traditional-only feature check; DMA disabled at launch
boot_context_test.nonce_source: host Python secrets.token_bytes for each test process; trusted host CSPRNG assumption
boot_context_test.reset_test: private QMP system_reset with -no-reboot exits cleanly with no second boot output

admin_ipc_test.credential: public RFC 8032 vector 1 only; fresh host test-launch nonce
admin_ipc_test.policy_authority: administrator private channel only; terminal/test client has signed submission, never direct policy administration
admin_ipc_test.guest_checks: signature/replay/stale-state denials; 12 correlated policy receipts and independent live-status/read checks; audit-full reductions apply while grants/restores do not; subsequent UART denies administration
admin_ipc_test.native_failure_checks: all receipt words/shape corrupted after commit leave pending; nested MR clobber; audit failure/invalid ack; duplicate execution; nonwrapping counters; 176 receipt combinations
admin_ipc_test.final_state: subject 1 quarantined, generation 8, no rights, audit full

isolation_test.checks: kernel child identity/order, VM-fault tag, four words, address, PC range/alignment, instruction/data, read/write, exception class, instruction length, translation/permission syndrome
isolation_test.canary: dedicated policy-owned test page; read-only observer alias; unchanged before/after all probes
isolation_test.policy_metadata: caller remains restricted with zero generation, object, and rights before/after every probe
isolation_test.post_fault_tests: full release UART suite including three injected serial breaks passed

native_policy_tests: passed with address and undefined-behavior sanitizers
terminal_core_tests: passed with address and undefined-behavior sanitizers; linked into separate terminal runtime
serial_adapter_tests: passed under sanitizers with mocked IPC/registers
self_status_tests: passed sanitized adapters and actual QEMU lifecycle/terminal paths
self_status_subject_selection: fixed policy channel identity; zero request words at every hop
self_status_audit_independence: debug terminal: 80 repeated UART queries followed by audit record 1 for first read
terminal_qemu_tests: passed real UART commands, policy denial, malformed input, overflow and recovery
terminal_adapter_tests: passed full/partial TX, echo ordering, loss, malformed reply tests under sanitizers
qemu_serial_break_recovery: both terminal profiles pass Enter and Ctrl-C recovery; debug audit sequence proves interrupted commands did not reach policy
qmp_transport: private temporary Unix socket; no TCP listener
